evidence.observedFact: The active salon listing states that cancellations or reschedules within 24 hours require payment of 50% of booked services and that excessive lateness can force rescheduling with a full-service cancellation fee.
The salon instructs clients to call or text to cancel because it does not always see email or Instagram/Facebook messages, creating a concrete multi-channel follow-up friction signal.
The business-owned booking page lists the Mentor location and phone number and offers current booking for lash, brow and related beauty services.
The City of Mentor reports that the business was founded in 2014, expanded its service menu as its team grew, and operates from 7341 Center Street in Mentor.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated appointment confirmations, cancellation recovery, and rebooking workflows around high-value recurring beauty services.
Demonstrate a single tracked follow-up workflow that captures booking and cancellation intent across web, text, and social inquiry channels.
Demonstrate win-back reminders for overdue recurring-service clients and clients whose appointments were cancelled or rescheduled.

notes: Observed fact: the salon publicly documents cancellation/reschedule penalties and explicitly says some digital message channels may not be seen. Hypothesis: centralized follow-up and reactivation automation could reduce missed opportunities. No monetary loss is estimated.
